standard.summary: 在训练过程中，若 GPU 温度超过阈值则暂停 N 分钟等待冷却，防止持续高温损坏 GPU。
standard.effect: cooldown_until_temp_c = 降到此温度后才恢复训练；poll_seconds = 每隔多少秒检查一次温度；minutes = 最大等待时间（超过后强制继续）。
standard.whenToUse: GPU 温度经常超过 85°C 的训练环境（散热不良、超频显卡）推荐设置保护。
standard.avoidWhen: GPU 温度正常（<80°C）或有良好散热时无需设置，徒增训练时间。

standard_en.summary: Pauses for N minutes when the GPU temperature crosses a threshold, waiting for it to cool so sustained heat does not damage the card.
standard_en.effect: cooldown_until_temp_c = resume only once it drops to this temperature; poll_seconds = how often the temperature is checked; minutes = the maximum wait (after which the run continues regardless).
standard_en.whenToUse: Recommended as protection in environments where the GPU regularly exceeds 85C (poor cooling, an overclocked card).
standard_en.avoidWhen: Unnecessary when temperatures are normal (<80C) or cooling is good -- it only lengthens the run.

advanced.principle: 通过 nvidia-smi 轮询 GPU 温度，超过阈值时调用 time.sleep 暂停训练步骤。cooldown_until_temp_c 比 cooldown_minutes 更精准（基于实际温度），两者可以一起设置（哪个条件先满足就继续）。
advanced.tradeoffs: 频繁冷却暂停会显著延长总训练时间；建议先改善散热条件（清灰、增加机箱风扇）再依赖软件温控。

advanced_en.principle: Polls GPU temperature via nvidia-smi and calls time.sleep to pause training steps above the threshold. cooldown_until_temp_c is more precise than cooldown_minutes (based on actual temperature); both can be set (whichever condition is met first resumes).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Frequent cooling pauses significantly lengthen total training time; improve cooling first (dust cleaning, case fans) before relying on software thermal control.
